verdicts.reason: A keeps the purple circle layered behind the Solstice can and reads cleanly top to bottom, but 'THE ULTRA TASTING TEAM' is set nearly as large and heavier than the quote, so it competes with the quote. There is also a dead gap between the quote mark and the quote, and the can is pushed against the bottom edge. B gets the attribution's size right, but the purple circle is cut off from the can and left on its own in the bottom corner, leaving a large empty lower third. Its quote text is also small for a 160px-wide format, and the centred logo doesn't share the left alignment the rest of the layout uses.
